gbm_population_evidence.quote: Diffuse Intrinsic Pontine Glioma; Diffuse Midline Glioma, H3 K27M-Mutant

candidate_evidence.quote: BALSTILIMAB is a human monoclonal antibody that targets programmed cell death 1 (PD1)
ZALIFRELIMAB is a human monoclonal immunoglobulin G1k subclass (IgG1k) antibody that specifically recognizes cytotoxic T lymphocyte-associated protein 4 (CTLA-4, also known as CD152)

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Subjects with newly diagnosed typical or non-typical, biopsy-proven DIPG or DMG are eligible for study enrollment.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: peak plasma concentration (Cmax) of BALSTILIMAB AND ZALIFRELIMAB in the blood

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: PBMC immune subsets measured via flow cytometry from peripheral blood samples

role_evidence.quote: Off-the-shelf, neoantigen heat shock protein vaccine

agents.drug_class_hint: neo-antigen heat shock protein peptide cancer vaccine
arms: Part A: rHSC-DIPGVax in Combination with BALSTILIMAB (Anti-PD1)
Part B: Dose Escalation of ZALIFRELIMAB (Anti-CTLA4)

role_evidence.quote: Part B: Dose Escalation of ZALIFRELIMAB (Anti-CTLA4): rHSC-DIPGVax (8 total doses) + BALSTILIMAB + ZALIFRELIMAB

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: anti-PD1 checkpoint blockade to overcome immunosuppressive microenvironment
